signIn.title: Sign in to Kiro
signIn.body: Sign in with Kiro's page (Google, GitHub, AWS Builder ID or IAM Identity Center), or save a Kiro API key.
signIn.key.label: Kiro API key
signIn.paste.kiro: Sign in on Kiro's page. It ends on an address that will not load (localhost:3128): copy its whole address from the browser's address bar and paste it below.
signIn.paste.aws: Kiro sent you on to AWS. Sign in there too; it also ends on an address that will not load: copy that whole address and paste it below.
signIn.paste.label: Address the sign-in ended on
signIn.error.empty: Paste the address the sign-in ended on.
signIn.error.otherSignIn: That address is from another sign-in; start this one again.
signIn.error.noIssuer: Kiro's page didn't say where to sign in at AWS.
signIn.error.external: A company's own identity provider can't be signed in to here; use a Kiro API key or another method.
signIn.error.unknown: Kiro's page came back with a sign-in this plugin doesn't know ({detail}).
